labels.note: attrEqIdx becomes last '=' not first; attribute values containing '=' get mis-split (e.g. base64-like values).
attrEqIdx>=endIdx can never be true given loop structure (break on ';' before checking '='); dead-code guard.
Same unreachable condition as >=; attrEqIdx is always < endIdx by construction, so operator change is inert.
Boundary shift: an attribute value of exactly 1024 octets is now wrongly ignored; narrow edge case.
If Domain has no '=' (val undefined), mutant calls val.charCodeAt(0) causing an uncaught TypeError crash.
Normal 'path' attr falls to default with identical result; only malformed empty-name attrs now get set as path.
Removing early break is masked: new Date(undefined/'') yields Invalid Date, already filtered by isFinite check.
maxDate becomes 400 days in the past, so nearly all real expires dates get clamped to a past date, breaking expiry.
